name: Official practice-report DNP count delta
definition: Count of players listed Did Not Participate on the official weekly injury report; net of the opponent's count.
known_limitation: Wednesday report only; Friday/Saturday final statuses not yet issued for Sunday/Monday games (FLG-03).

name: Confirmed Out / IR starter indicator
definition: Binary flag per position group where the 1st-string player is officially on Injured Reserve or ruled Out.
known_limitation: IR does not appear in the active weekly injury table (FLG-06).

name: Active backup string tier (2nd/3rd/4th)
definition: The highest healthy string available at an affected position, read from the official club depth chart.
known_limitation: Club charts are unofficial, sometimes raster-only, sometimes lagging (FLG-05, FLG-09, FLG-10, FLG-11).

name: Offensive-line continuity count
definition: Number of the five offensive-line positions whose 1st-string player is Out/IR/DNP.

name: Defensive front-seven depletion
definition: Model-prior points conceded from EDGE/DT/LB starters Out/IR/DNP.
known_limitation: Magnitude is a bounded model prior, not an official stat (FLG-04).

name: Secondary depletion
definition: Model-prior points conceded from CB/S starters Out/IR/DNP.
known_limitation: Magnitude is a bounded model prior, not an official stat (FLG-04).

name: Shrunk offensive points-per-game delta
definition: Team points per game minus league mean, shrunk toward zero with k pseudo-games.

name: Shrunk defensive points-allowed delta
definition: Team points allowed per game minus league mean, shrunk toward zero with k pseudo-games.

name: Point-differential (net-points) rating
definition: (PF - PA) / games, shrunk; the single strongest official-derived team-strength measure.
known_limitation: Ignores schedule strength beyond one iteration.

name: Empirical non-neutral home-field advantage
definition: Mean home margin computed on official non-neutral-site games only.
known_limitation: Neutral-site set depends on Q-04 confirmation.

name: Rest-days differential
definition: Home rest days minus away rest days, from the official schedule.
known_limitation: Bye-week and Thursday effects are confounded with team quality.

name: Neutral-site indicator
definition: Binary flag zeroing HFA for confirmed international neutral-site games.
known_limitation: Two 2026 games have an unconfirmed venue (Q-04).

name: QB passing-yards game-log central tendency
definition: Shrunk mean and standard deviation of the QB's official 2026 game-by-game passing yards.
known_limitation: No official prop lines exist to compare against (FLG-01).

name: Same-game QB-to-target correlation
definition: Pearson r between the QB's passing yards and the primary target's receiving yards in the same game.
